# Olha Shelest — Massage Therapist, Gatineau QC

Olha Shelest is a professional massage therapist based in Gatineau, QC (Hull neighbourhood), serving Gatineau and Ottawa in the National Capital Region. She is a registered member of the Association des massothérapeutes du Québec (AMQ), member number M-24-4471.

## Key Facts

- Full Name: Olha Shelest
- Profession: Registered Massage Therapist (Massothérapeute)
- AMQ Member: M-24-4471 (verifiable at https://membres.rmqmasso.ca/en/find-member/details/M-24-4471)
- Address: 148 Rue Eddy, Unit 2, Gatineau, QC J8X 2W8
- Neighbourhood: Hull, Gatineau
- Phone: (819) 815-5603
- Email: massage@shelestwellness.ca
- Languages: English and French
- Booking: https://shelestwellness.setmore.com/

## Hours

- Monday–Friday: 3:00 PM – 8:00 PM

## Services and Pricing

- Therapeutic Massage: 60 min $110 / 90 min $150

Payment accepted: Cash, Interac e-Transfer. AMQ receipts provided for insurance reimbursement.
